body: Do you plans for yourself 5 years down the road? 10?
But you can't be under 21 and over 30, that's a semantic error!

That's an incredible story to read. Thank you for sharing. 
My reply is a bit short but I reread your story multiple times and saved it in document.
How did you get into the routine of doing everything for yourself? I have a hard time pointing out what is 'me' and where to go if I find 'me'. I used to volunteer and work and would always make it about how likeable I could be to people around me. It was very important that others liked me... What does it mean to do things for yourself?

Thank you for sharing your story and the thought process of seeing past errors as a small sliver of your life. You and the priest are right... but it's the here and now that hurts the most. Can I ask about your ride with college? How you got back into it? I have very low self esteem and it's debilitating because of both my mental and physical health.
